description: This file defines extension methods for adding grain directory providers to an Orleans silo builder and service collection, including registration and lifecycle participation logic.

classes.name: NoOpLifecycleParticipant
classes.description: A singleton implementation of ILifecycleParticipant that performs no actions during lifecycle participation.

methods.name: AddGrainDirectory
methods.description: Extension method to add a grain directory provider to the silo builder, registering the implementation factory and ensuring lifecycle participation if applicable.

methods.name: AddGrainDirectory
methods.description: Extension method to add a grain directory provider to the service collection, registering the directory by name, implementation factory, and lifecycle participant.

methods.name: GetGrainDirectories
methods.description: Retrieves all registered grain directories from the service provider.
